title: 金太郎 (Kintarō — Golden Boy)
description: A boy of extraordinary strength lives on Mt. Ashigara with his mother, playing sumo wrestling with bears and deer, and chopping trees to build bridges for his animal friends. One day the famous samurai Minamoto no Yorimitsu discovers him and invites him to come to the capital. Kintarō grows up to become the celebrated warrior 坂田公時, one of the Four Heavenly Kings of Yorimitsu. A beloved children's folk tale celebrating strength, kindness, and nature.
author: 楠山正雄 (Kusuyama Masao, 1885–1943)
license: Public Domain (青空文庫 — 楠山正雄 died 1943; PD in Japan since 2014 under 70-year rule)
